map.通过力竭次数推算自重动作（俯卧撑/引体向上）的一次最大重复 1RM 与相对力量，: Estimates the one-rep max and relative strength for bodyweight movements (push-ups, pull-ups) from the number of reps to failure, helping set training loads.
map.；Brzycki：1RM = 负荷 / (1.0278 − 0.0278×次数): ; Brzycki: 1RM = load / (1.0278 − 0.0278 × reps). For bodyweight movements the load = bodyweight × load ratio (about 64% for push-ups) or bodyweight + added weight (for pull-ups).
map.输入体重与可完成的力竭次数。: Enter your bodyweight and the reps you can complete to failure.
map.结果区显示 Epley、Brzycki 与均值 1RM 及相对力量（1RM/体重: The result panel shows the Epley, Brzycki, and mean 1RM plus relative strength (1RM / bodyweight).
map.设定自重训练强度（如 70%–80% 1RM 用于增肌）。: Set bodyweight training intensity (for example 70%–80% 1RM for hypertrophy).
map.次数越多（>15）推算精度越差；超过 15 次建议直接测试真实 1RM 或缩短次: The higher the rep count (>15), the worse the estimate; beyond 15 reps, test your true 1RM directly or use fewer reps.
map.力竭次数越多越准吗？: Does More Reps to Failure Improve Accuracy?
map.不是。1RM 公式在低次数（1–10）更可靠，次数过高误差增大。: No. The 1RM formulas are more reliable at low rep counts (1–10); the error grows as reps increase.
map.相对力量有什么用？: What Is Relative Strength Good For?
map.消除体重差异，便于不同体重者横向比较力量水平。: It removes the bodyweight difference so people of different weights can compare strength levels fairly.
